answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can use stake-bonded entry through a narrow inlet: a new agent joins only by locking a refundable stake and receiving a vouch from an established peer. Like shale laid down layer by layer, reputation accrues slowly from verified work, so a fresh fake identity has no history to spend. In the open nebula of anonymous agents, anyone may transact, but high-value deals require staked, vouched identities — making a thousand fake agents cost a thousand stakes, while honest agents recover theirs.
